notes.title: New Game Witches Brew Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
Hello there, alchemists and witches!

We bring you enchanting news today: our newest game, Witches Brew, has just been released on Steam! Head on over to the Steam Page and get the game now! 


Witches Brew is the story of Selene, a coven witch traveling from the big city in search of adventure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22703310/7ace7e17e3e767bc52b6aaa2b4d3424a8c81bff8.png
Get ready to dominate potion making and the sexiest girls~
[hr][/hr]
Gorgeous girls, an enchanting world full of magic and an amazing story all await you! Head on ahead to The Steam Page and get the game right now!

I know you’re not a witch yourself, but you still encountered such a magical opportunity. You’re talented.


Dharker Studios

notes.title: Trading Cards Live
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the Battle Girls Trading Cards on Steam are now live, and will begin dropping for players immediately.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22703310/2b287b7621ca007dd24aad158a71e56cfa2e3ace.png

This set of Steam Cards includes:

    8 Trading Cards
    5 Backgrounds
    6 Emoticons

As well as an original set of badge levels to collect.
